name: Kettlebell Lunge Pass-Through
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart holding a single kettlebell in your right hand at your side.
Step forward into a lunge with your left leg while keeping your torso tall and core braced.
At the bottom of the lunge, pass the kettlebell smoothly underneath your front left thigh from your right hand to your left hand.
Push off the left foot to stand, then alternate the leading leg and receiving hand with each lunge.
tips: Avoid hunching your shoulders forward when passing the kettlebell underneath your leg.
Keep your front knee aligned over your toes and step wide enough for solid balance.
